{{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = [[Tech]]|weakness = [[Warrior]]|image1 = File:Class Use Scout.png}}'''Scout'''s are one of six Bot Classes in ''[[Transformers: Forged to Fight]]''. It has a Class Bonus against [[Tech]]s, but is weak to [[Warrior]]s.

==In-Game Description==
''Scout Bots quickly eliminate opponents with frequent Special Attacks and a high Critical Rate.''
*Frequent critical attacks and damaging debuffs from [[Scout]] Bots are effective against the high base attributes of [[Tech]] bots.
*Most Scouts have [[Evade]] abilities that help them automatically avoid attacks.
*Scouts have a high critical rate, but low Health rating.
*Scouts' abilities can neutralize Tech Bots' abilities like Power buffs and shields.

== Strategies ==
Scouts are speedy and critical in their movements and attacks. They love Critical Hits to the point a Commander can count them as fast as they can beat story Act 1. They also love Special Attacks, and their Evasion buffs mask their low health rating. They're also able to find a way around [[Tech]] bots' abilities like defensive shields and power gains, so expect the mighty [[Shockwave]] to tremble against Generations [[Bumblebee]] in a match-up. And as stated above, Scouts, like their [[Warrior|worst nightmares]], love Critical ''Hit''s, but never increase their critical ''damage''.

Scouts are somewhat annoying to fight due to their scouty slipperiness expected from the typical scout Bot, so while any other class type works, a Warrior can neutralize their evasion, making sure they're forged not to evade, but to be stuck without evasion.

==List of Scout Bots==
*[[Windblade]]
*[[Sideswipe]]
*[[Barricade]]
*[[Prowl]]
*[[Bumblebee]]
*[[Kickback]]
*[[Sharkticon]] Scout
*[[Cheetor]]
*[[Jazz]]
*[[S-1000]] (when obtained by the player)
*[[Slipstream]]
